newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS - PRICES MOSTLY STEADY.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS - PRICES MOSTLY STEADY.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady Wednesday amid lackluster activity, dealers said.
"Nobody seems to want to buy anything," a Texas dealer said. He said that was "surprising" since corn and soybean futures rose on CBOT.
In the U.S. northeast, reduced flour mill runtimes rather than an improvement in demand have underpinned prices.
"The unexpected loss of runtime continued to support the northeast market. Last weekend a couple of mills lost some time," a Buffalo dealer said.
He said if mills were running normally, "we would certainly have some pressure on the market." But right now, it's the change in runtime rather than a change in demand, the Buffalo dealer added.
